india.one_line: India signs AI supply chain pact, OpenAI expands local leadership, and Sarvam launches domestic inference.

themes.title: India joins AI supply chain pact
themes.text: India and nine other nations signed the San Francisco Declaration on the Secure Foundations of Enduring Prosperity at the Pax Silica retreat on November 15, aiming to protect AI infrastructure and sensitive technologies.

stories.headline: India and nine nations sign declaration to safeguard AI supply chains

themes.title: Local AI infrastructure and leadership grow
themes.text: OpenAI named Pragya Misra to lead business development for India and South Asia, citing over 100 million weekly users in the country. Meanwhile, Sarvam AI launched Token Factory, an OpenAI-compatible API serving its Sarvam 105B model and global open-weight models on Indian GPU clusters, processing over 450 billion DeepSeek tokens daily.

stories.headline: OpenAI names Pragya Misra to lead business development in India and South Asia
Sarvam AI opens Token Factory to run global open-weight models on Indian servers

themes.title: Meta adjusts Instagram AI for India
themes.text: Meta modified Instagram's recommendation systems in India to proactively filter sexually suggestive and violent content across Reels, Explore, and Feed, using advanced AI models following regulatory scrutiny.

stories.headline: Meta modifies Instagram recommendation systems in India to curb violent content
